notes:
A calmer, clearer instrument (UX pass 1):
• Time tape: drag the engraved ruler under the gold index; flick to coast; tap a gold mark to jump to that event.
• Tempo dial replaces the speed menu: tap = faster, hold = slower, or swipe.
• Tap a planet on the wheel: the centre shows its live position and 144,000 address. Taps no longer stop live time.
• Labels never shrink below readable sizes and spread apart with leader lines.
• Unfolded: nothing sits on the crease; the time controls live on the wheel page.
• Plates: ● in / ○ out, equal width; drag a plate down or up, or tap.
• Shows: GO is the one big button; ✕ in the corner.
• Debug overlay moved into Settings.

apk.notes: Fixes the updater so this app version checks for and installs updates by itself. Settings › Updates shows the build and last check.
